name: io.github.jeswr/solid-mcp
title: Solid Pod
description: Scoped Solid pod tools, conversation archives and purpose-limited personal context.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_POD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Required absolute pod/container URL ending in /.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_WEBID
environmentVariables.description: Optional owner WebID; needed for chat and personal tools.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Optional owner-chosen account label recorded on captured or imported conversations.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Defaults to true. Set false explicitly to enable writes.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: CSS client-credentials token id. Supply with secret and issuer or token URL.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: CSS client-credentials token secret. Supply with ID and issuer or token URL.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_OIDC_ISSUER
environmentVariables.description: Issuer for discovery. With any auth setting, credentials and issuer or token URL are required.

environmentVariables.name: SOLID_MCP_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit token endpoint URL; overrides discovery. This is an endpoint, not a token.
